en: Theravāda Vinaya Bhikkhunīvibhaṅga Pācittiyakaṇḍa
The Chapter on Turning Over.
31. The Training Rule on Sitting on the Same Bed.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, two bhikkhunīs were lying down on the same bed.
People wandering for alms through the monastery saw them and criticized, grumbled, and complained, saying:
"How can these bhikkhunīs lie down on the same bed? They are just like householders who indulge in sensual pleasures!"
The bhikkhunīs heard those people grumbling, complaining, and criticizing.
Those bhikkhunīs who were of few desires... [and so on]... they grumbled, complained, and criticized:
"How can these bhikkhunīs lie down together on the same bed?"... [and so on]...
“Is it true, monks, that nuns are lying down on the same bed, two together?
“It is true, Blessed One.
The Buddha, the Blessed One, rebuked them … [as before] …
“How indeed, bhikkhus, can bhikkhunīs lie down on the same bed, one with another?
This, bhikkhus, is neither for the inspiration of those without faith nor for the increase of those with faith...
And thus, bhikkhus, should the bhikkhunīs recite this training rule: ‘If any bhikkhunī should lie down on the same bed with another bhikkhunī, that is an offense of expiation.’”
“Whatever nuns should lie down on the same bed, it is an offense of expiation (pācittiya).
Regarding the phrase “whatever [nuns]”: whoever they may be... [and so forth].
"Bhikkhunīs" refers to those who have received full ordination.
"Two should lie down on one bed" means...
If one lies down while another is already lying down, there is an offense of expiation (pācittiya).
Or if both lie down together, there is an offense of expiation.
If they rise up and lie down again and again, there is an offense of expiation for each instance.
There is no offense if one who is lying down sits while another is already seated,
or if both sit down together.
[The offense does not apply] to those who are insane, nor to beginners.
The first training rule is concluded.
